observations: Wall-mounted salon hood hair dryer, white body with dark gray/black bonnet and arm, mounted on a black wall bracket.
Brand label on the front reads 'MANGO' (visible in photos 0, 1, 2, 3), with smaller text 'AUTOMATIC' and what appears to be a blue logo strip below it.
Two control dials/knobs visible on the front panel under the brand badge (photo 1), one with a red indicator light.
Power cord visible hanging from the arm joint (photos 0, 1, 2).
Unit appears intact, no visible cracks, scratches, or missing parts on the hood or bonnet.
Wall bracket and swing arm look sturdy, consistent with a professional salon hood dryer mount.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'MAXIE' overlay all four photos, confirming they are listing photos, not independent proof.
No photo shows the dryer powered on, the digital/analog timer in use, the bonnet interior, or the underside/control panel close-up.
No close-up of any rating plate, serial number, or model number distinct from the brand name is visible.
